name: Mass Healing Word
description: Level 3 Abjuration (Bard, Doctor) Casting Time: Bonus Action Range: 60 feet Components: V Duration: Instantaneous Up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain Health equal to 2d4 plus your spellcasting ability modifier. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The healing increases by 1d4 for each spell slot level above 3.
